notes.title: Price finally changed
notes.content: Price finally approved by Valve. Now the regular price is half size than before.

notes.title: We're going to lower the price
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Thank you for your support and all guys and gals who bought our game for an 8$ price tag!
We've got a lot of feedback and going to lower the game price. So if you are want to buy it right now - probably you should wait a couple of days.
